## What's new in 0.4.0

- **A new table:** a floor of dark flagstones, from pebbles to the odd boulder, with grass, moss and glowing mushrooms in the joints, and a slow river winding around your seat.
- **Cards land properly:** a card played to the battlefield now folds into its tile instead of snapping into a different-looking card, for the bots' cards as well as yours, and whether it enters tapped or attached.
- **Casting choices in one place:** when a card can be cast more than one way (plot it, pay an alternative cost, pick a half, choose X or kicker), the choices and the Cast and Cancel buttons sit together in the prompt in the middle of the table.
- **Clearer choices:** a window that offers cards from more than one place, like Highway Robbery's "discard a card or sacrifice a land", now shows your hand and your battlefield under their own headings.
- **Fixes:** Roaming Throne's ward now works, so an opponent targeting it must pay or have their spell countered; relaunching ArenaEDH.exe while it is already running hands its window to the running program.

## Download

Download **ArenaEDH.exe** below and double-click it. There's nothing to install, and it runs on Windows 10 and 11.

The first time, Windows may say "Windows protected your PC", because the program isn't signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

To play with friends on other computers, everyone needs this same version.
